title: Baked Ukrainian Pasta
description: A keto twist on traditional pasta, featuring Ukrainian flavors and a crispy bake.
instructions: Cook the Ukrainian pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, mix together the pasta sauce, oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and dried oregano.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish.
Top with bake cheese and sprinkle with parsley.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
